problem: Native children of an independently visible external task can change the established runtime metadata without appearing as separate app task rows. Attempt8 identified three already-existing children by exact native parent UUID. Initial descendant inventory resolves that observed freeze failure; a future new child needs an explicit observation route, not inferred app visibility.
unchanged: P1-only finite review batches/IDs/projects/roots/bytes/checkpoints, immutable initial baseline and ordered receipt chain.
No wildcard or recursive ancestry allowance, existing-row reclassification, external control, metadata mutation, body/title/config/credential reads or proof-member promotion.

proposed_route.versioning: Add explicitly selected observation protocol2 to a new P1 scope. Dispatch closed direct_task and direct_child observation variants. Preserve version1 direct-task receipt parsing/meaning and every existing evidence byte; reject mixed versions or unknown fields. No Task/native/grant schema version is changed by this receipt-only extension.
proposed_route.direct_task: Retain exact independently app-observed native task plus selected native metadata. The app-observed ID is that task itself.
proposed_route.direct_child: Record child nativeID separately from app-observed parent nativeID. The child is observed only through selected native metadata and an exact supported stored child→parent edge; report no direct child app visibility.
proposed_route.eligible_parent: The exact parent UUID must be an explicitly reviewed external identity in initial external accounting rows, a prior accepted external direct-task delta, or a directly app-observed external parent in this same bounded challenge. A parent in the same challenge must independently pass the direct_task variant. In every case the parent must be actually observed in the app at this decision; mere eligibility is insufficient.
proposed_route.lineage: Parse only the current pinned-runtime stored source variant subagent.thread_spawn. Require exact actual parent_thread_id UUID equality and bind the raw source-field digest, child stable metadata digest and the separately observed parent stable metadata. Reject unsupported source variants/unknown fields, alternate-parent and deeper-only relationships. One edge is validated; no ancestor search or path-name pattern confers identity.
proposed_route.metadata: Child and parent are nonarchived current local metadata identities; actual child cwd equals parent canonical cwd and the unique selected native project-root association. Preserve distinct native projectID and app projectID. Reopen source/parent/log identity immediately before acceptance and require only already allowed monotonic progress. No transcript/header base-instruction contents are read.
proposed_route.exclusions: Exclude exact global host/manager/implementer native UUIDs bound in the initial own-execution rows, every currently returned/known proof actor, every retained prior proof UUID, and all corresponding protected proof paths. Apply exclusions to BOTH parent and child. /root/workerN and nicknames are display metadata, never global identity or authority.
proposed_route.receipt: Protocol2 decision observation has an explicit kind; direct_child binds child_native_id,parent_native_id,the actual app parent record reference,the exact read-only child/parent metadata record references and source-edge digests. Scope/baseline/previous/batch/challenge/addition IDs and host-file identity guards stay unchanged. App evidence and child metadata evidence remain visibly separate.
proposed_route.budget: Both new child and any newly added parent consume the existing new-ID limits. An initial or previously reviewed parent consumes no second identity count. Same-batch parent+child uses two of the fixed two-ID batch slots. No automatic splitting of an oversized unknown delta or blanket descendant approval.
proposed_route.initial_inventory: Before a future freeze root supplies the exact currently identified active descendants as explicit initial rows. Those pre-existing rows are not converted into additions and no descendant wildcard is stored. This assessment adds no automatic recursive discovery/admission.

acceptance_cases: Positive exact app-visible external parent and one newly observed native child with the authentic stored direct edge; parent/child app visibility claims remain distinct.
Positive initial-parent, previously accepted direct-task-parent and same-batch directly app-observed parent variants; preserve count semantics and ordered receipt replay.
Reject a missing app parent observation, unrelated parent, swapped child, unsupported/malformed/duplicate-key source, ancestry-only association, spoofed /root/workerN label or changed source edge.
Reject any global host/manager/implementer/proof/retained UUID in either role, including an otherwise app-visible global host.
Reject changed initial metadata, archived/relocated identities, wrong cwd/root association and mixed/unknown receipt version/fields.

Recheck before adoption: new extra identities, source-edge or parent stable-field changes and budget/deadline exhaustion remain failures. Existing direct-task and all prior admission/partial-initialization tests keep passing.
activation: Separate root assessment required before schema implementation. Current writer is scoped only to partial-initialization/failure reporting. After reconciliation, bind the accepted exact route in its governed same-instance context; no native retry until fresh packet review.
